$comment: Hooks per GENERAL_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md 5.2. Claude Code CLI only.
Path is extracted with python3 rather than jq: the playbook's own note is
that a hook which fails because a tool is missing is worse than no hook,
because it trains you to ignore hook output. The extractor never fails
loudly -- it prints an empty line and exits 0, so `case` matches nothing.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; e=json.load(sys.stdin); print((e.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (e.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/dynaflows/*.py) uv run python scripts/lint_architecture.py "$f" ;; esac; }

python3 -c "import json,sys; e=json.load(sys.stdin); print((e.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (e.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null | { read -r f; base="$(basename "$f" .py)"; case "$f" in */src/dynaflows/*.py) if [ "$base" != "__init__" ] && [ -f "tests/unit/test_${base}.py" ]; then uv run pytest -q "tests/unit/test_${base}.py"; fi ;; esac; }

python3 -c "import json,sys; e=json.load(sys.stdin); print((e.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (e.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.toml) uv run python -c "import tomllib,sys; tomllib.load(open(sys.argv[1],'rb')); print('TOML OK:', sys.argv[1])" "$f" || echo "TOML INVALID: $f" ;; *.json) python3 -c "import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print('JSON OK:', sys.argv[1])" "$f" || echo "JSON INVALID: $f" ;; esac; }

python3 -c "import json,sys; e=json.load(sys.stdin); print((e.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (e.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null | { read -r f; case "$f" in */.env.example|*/settings.py) uv run python -c "import re,pathlib; ex=set(re.findall(r'^#?\s*([A-Z_]+)=', pathlib.Path('.env.example').read_text(), re.M)); req=set(re.findall(r'\"([A-Z_]+)\"', re.search(r'REQUIRED_VARS[^)]*\)', pathlib.Path('src/dynaflows/settings.py').read_text(), re.S).group(0))); missing=req-ex; print('DRIFT: REQUIRED_VARS not in .env.example:', missing) if missing else print('env contract OK')" ;; esac; }

python3 -c "import json,sys; e=json.load(sys.stdin); print((e.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (e.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null | { read -r f; case "$f" in */docs/*.md) uv run dynaflows index --check ;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: ADR-009: checking the playbook index for drift...
